reason: The existing mapping to Article 11(6) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 is defensible and complete. The evidence, specifically Article 11(6)(a), directly supports the control objective by mandating the annual testing of ICT business continuity and response/recovery plans, as well as testing after substantive changes to critical or important functions.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to financial entities under the DORA regulation, which requires them to test their ICT business continuity plans annually and after major changes.
challenge_comment: The mapping is clear and directly supported by the text of the regulation. No additional provisions are needed to establish the required testing frequency and triggers.
